_comment: Glimmerline's hosted remote config (ITERATION-7, 2026-10-30): the document served at https://sixandahalf.studio/glimmerline/remote_config.json (copied to the studio site repo as /glimmerline/remote_config.json), the URL config/secrets.json names as remote_config_url before the rc4 release build. The same shape as config/remote_defaults.json, which is the fallback with the same values when this file is unreachable. ads_enabled false: the Google Mobile Ads SDK is never initialized, consent for analytics is the app's own sheet, the Store sells no pass; allowance_enabled false: no daily allowance. The one-line flip: set ads_enabled to true (only after AdMob approves the account and the GDPR and US-state messages are published in AdMob -> Privacy & messaging), push the site repo, and every install picks it up at its next launch after GitHub Pages' cache, about ten minutes; nothing else changes without a release. Units: puzzles, seconds, days; cartridges.<id> holds a cartridge's own values, merged over the flat ones for that app.
